queries.sql: SELECT id,created_at,payload->>'occurred_at' occurred_at,payload->>'sql_caller_count' declared_callers,jsonb_array_length(payload->'sql_callers') callers,payload->'scope_guards' scope_guards,payload->'historical_provenance_only' historical_limits FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161;
queries.result: event 20161 at 2026-10-04; declared/actual callers=38; scope guards say no production/runtime/caller changes by that snapshot; historical note says router 5.12 vs governed readiness 5.13 and old contract existence is not usage evidence.

queries.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT payload FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161), h AS (SELECT x->>'caller' caller,x->>'definition_md5' historical_md5 FROM e,jsonb_array_elements(payload->'sql_callers') x), l AS (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||p.proname caller,md5(p.prosrc) current_md5 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace) SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.caller IS NULL) absent_current,count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.caller IS NOT NULL AND h.historical_md5=l.current_md5) empirical_match,count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.caller IS NOT NULL AND h.historical_md5<>l.current_md5) empirical_changed FROM h LEFT JOIN l USING(caller);
queries.result: 38 total; 0 absent current names; 16 empirical md5(prosrc) matches; 22 empirical changes.

assumptions: snapshot describes its observation time only
empirical md5(prosrc) is a comparison, not proof of historical hash recipe

findings.claim: The historical snapshot is valid only as-of its own observation and cannot by itself certify current caller definitions.
22/38 caller names differ by empirical current md5(prosrc); historical hash construction remains UNKNOWN.
